name: text-link
title: Text link
description: The inline link: one underline, one focus ring, and it says when it opens a new tab, downloads a file or marks the page you are on.
docs: Use it for links inside running text and short link lists; for a button that navigates, use Button with asChild. tone is underlined (the default: foreground text with a quiet underline that darkens on hover), subtle (muted, underlined only on hover and focus, for footers and link lists) or inherit (takes the colour around it, for banners and alerts, and draws its focus ring in that colour too, so the ring shows on a filled surface). The underline offset and thickness are in em, so they scale with the text, and the focus ring is drawn again on every line when a link wraps. external opens a new tab with rel=noopener, adds a small up-right arrow that stays on the last word and a hidden 'opens in a new tab'. download is true, a file name, or { filename, type, size }: type and size ({ type: 'PDF', size: 2_411_000 }) are shown as 'PDF, 2.4 MB', with the size written out in the locale you pass, and a screen reader hears 'download' before them. current marks the link to the page you are on with aria-current (page by default, or 'step', 'location', 'date', 'time') and a heavier weight. disabled renders a span with role=link and aria-disabled instead of an anchor, so it is never a dead tab stop. hrefLang sets the attribute and adds a hidden 'in German' (the name comes from Intl.DisplayNames). asChild puts the same look on your framework link: pass <Link href> with the text inside as the only child. labels holds the hidden words for another language. textLinkVariants is exported so other components can borrow the look.
